creator: Alexander Terp
description:
MIP-3 section 13. `crates/herdr-harness` spawns the pinned herdr per test under a scratch XDG directory. The daemon cards need the same for `muster-daemon`, built from the same commit: no pin, no download.

Parts of herdr-harness are not herdr-shaped and should move rather than be copied: `until.rs` (the repo's single `until` with a single deadline) and `relay.rs` (`Daemon::withholding_answers_to`, which stages a request that lands but whose answer is lost). herdr-harness itself stays until the cut-over deletes it, so this is a new neutral crate those two move into, with herdr-harness re-exporting them in the meantime.

Constraint worth keeping in view: a spawned herdr answers in about 25 ms (`docs/testing.md`), and daemon-backed tests are only in the default gate because of that. The new daemon has to match, and the harness is the natural place to assert it.
title: A test harness that spawns muster-daemon instead of herdr
